arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Eric Feigin argued that encourage and induce mean solicitation in criminal law.
He cited legal treatises to support this narrow interpretation.
The government argued that Congress uses specific words for solicitation.
They claimed the current statutory language is much broader.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests the scope of a federal immigration law. The government argues the law bans any act that encourages illegal entry. The defense argues the law only bans solicitation or facilitation of the act itself.
